MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.14 (Google, Apache License 2.0), as published on npm
(`@mediapipe/tasks-vision`: `vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.*`), and its
hand landmarker model (`hand_landmarker.task`, float16, version 1, from
storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models). Unchanged. The page loads them only when a visitor
chooses to drive with a hand in front of the camera; the picture is read on the visitor's
device and never sent anywhere.
